# Radio group (`radio-group`)

One of several, vertical or inline.

Group: Choice & range. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/choice-inputs';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createRadioGroup` (types in `dist/web/choice-inputs/choiceGroup.d.ts`): `.mh-choice-group` of `.mh-radio`: native radios in a fieldset, so arrow keys move the choice and Tab enters and leaves the group, as on every platform.

```ts
export function createRadioGroup(options: RadioGroupOptions): RadioGroupHandle;

export interface RadioGroupOptions {
  /** The question the group answers; the `<legend>`. */
  legend: string;
  /** Keep the legend for screen readers only. */
  hideLegend?: boolean;
  options: readonly ChoiceOption[];
  value?: string;
  /** Form name; one is generated otherwise (radios need a shared name for arrow keys). */
  name?: string;
  /** Options side by side, wrapping. */
  inline?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onChange?: (value: string, event: Event) => void;
}

export interface RadioGroupHandle {
  el: HTMLFieldSetElement;
  inputs: HTMLInputElement[];
  getValue(): string | undefined;
  setValue(value: string | undefined): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createRadioGroup } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const status = document.createElement('p');
const mode = createRadioGroup({
  legend: 'Heating mode',
  value: 'auto',
  options: [
    { value: 'auto', label: 'Auto', description: 'Follow the weekly schedule.' },
    { value: 'comfort', label: 'Comfort' },
    { value: 'eco', label: 'Eco', description: 'Two degrees lower while nobody is home.' },
    { value: 'off', label: 'Off' },
  ],
  onChange: (value) => (status.textContent = `Heating mode: ${value}`),
});

document.body.append(mode.el, status);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { RadioGroup } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

const MODES = [
  { value: 'auto', label: 'Auto', description: 'Follow the weekly schedule.' },
  { value: 'comfort', label: 'Comfort' },
  { value: 'eco', label: 'Eco', description: 'Two degrees lower while nobody is home.' },
  { value: 'off', label: 'Off' },
];

export function RadioGroupExample() {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState('auto');
  return <RadioGroup legend="Heating mode" options={MODES} value={mode} onChange={(value) => setMode(value)} />;
}
```
